name: Farmhouse Sea n Sand
description: Premier sea-facing restaurant on the Pachubandar coast with panoramic sunset views over the Arabian Sea, famous for signature Koliwada prawns, stuffed pomfret, and live weekend music.
address: Pachubandar Coastal Road, Near Vasai Fort Jetty, Vasai West

name: Kinara Bar & Restaurant
description: Long-standing, renowned coastal eatery in Pachubandar, praised by locals for fresh catch crab masala, butter garlic prawns, surmai fry, and chilled Solkadhi.
address: Fish Market Road, Pachubandar, Vasai West

name: Salt Pan Restaurant and Bar
description: Chic and spacious retreat near Bhuigaon Dongri, featuring open-air salt pan vistas, rooftop seating, excellent fresh coastal thalis, and grilled fish.
address: Bhuigaon Dongri Road, Near Nirmal Church, Giriz, Vasai West

name: Kokum Restaurant
description: Elegant coastal family dining restaurant at Bhabola Naka, specializing in coastal Malvani thalis, tisrya masala, chicken sukka, and fresh kokum solkadhi.
address: Bhabola Naka, Stella Road, Vasai West

name: Konkan Shubhanna
description: Authentic, pocket-friendly fish thali spot where dishes are prepared by local housewives using traditional Konkani stone-ground spices.
address: Near Railway Station Ticket Window, Vasai East

name: Farmhouse Fun Fiesta
description: Popular large family dining and recreational restaurant in Nalasopara with extensive seafood, tandoori, and Chinese menus.
address: Near Fun Fiesta Multiplex, Sriprastha, Nalasopara West

name: Manthan Family Restaurant & Bar
description: Established family restaurant known for hearty North Indian gravies, fresh fish fry, and swift service in Nalasopara.
address: Tulinj Road, Central Park, Nalasopara East
